direct_calls: schema_catalog/mod.rs imports fingerprint::fingerprint; ReflectSchemaCatalog::fingerprint caches fingerprint(&self.entries) in OnceLock.
snapshot includes the cached digest; try_from_snapshot validates algorithm_version, rebuilds from entries, and compares the recomputed digest and projections.
WorldReflection::list_reflect_types passes the full catalog digest into ReflectSchemaResponse, even if the returned registrations are filtered.
traits_and_api: Implements Display, Serialize as a string and Deserialize from hex; as_bytes borrows the fixed 32-byte array with lifetime tied to self.
fingerprint.registration_boundary: Encoder consumes admitted metadata; it does not validate registration values, install adapters, hash adapter identity/object address, or encode runtime registration generation.
fingerprint.ffi: No FFI declarations or C ABI calls occur in either formal file or traced direct Rust consumers.

direct_calls: field_id.rs sets ReflectFieldId::FromStr::Err to this enum; Uuid::parse_str failures become InvalidUuid { source }, then try_from_uuid maps nil UUID to Nil.
try_from_uuid rejects the all-zero UUID and returns an owned/copyable ID on success.
traits_and_api: Enum derives Clone, Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq and Eq.
InvalidUuid retains uuid::Error as source; Nil carries no payload.
The error enum has no serde implementation.
field_id_parse_error.ffi: No FFI declaration/call in the formal error type or traced parser use sites.

test_contracts.evidence: Uses reversed catalog entry input and reversed alias order, then asserts equal fingerprints and snapshots. Fixture has one dependency and does not independently exercise all hashed fields or multiple dependency ordering.
Changes registration display_name and expects snapshot revalidation to reject the fingerprint mismatch; separately increments algorithm_version and expects rejection.

Checks response algorithm version and equality with catalog.fingerprint(), then JSON round-trips ReflectSchemaResponse. Exercises fingerprint serde through the response, but asserts neither a golden digest nor exact hex text.
Checks stable-key determinism/differentiation, UUID Display/FromStr and serde round-trip, plus Nil rejection. It does not directly assert InvalidUuid or its source payload.
